title: FLIP — Federated Learning & Interoperability Platform
tagline: Federated learning across 11 NHS Trusts. Apache 2.0.
description: Open-source platform that lets researchers train AI on medical imaging and EHR data sitting inside NHS Trust firewalls — without moving patient data. Built on FastAPI microservices, Docker Swarm, AWS and OpenTofu, with NVIDIA FLARE and Flower as pluggable FL backends.

title: MONAI Core & MONAI Generative
tagline: Open-source contributor to medical-imaging AI frameworks.
description: Active contributions to MONAI Core and MONAI Generative, the libraries the wider medical-imaging research community relies on for deep-learning workflows.

title: Audify
description: Python pipeline and REST API that transforms written content into high-quality audio using multiple TTS providers (Kokoro, OpenAI, AWS Polly, Google Cloud), LLM translation with Ollama, and LLM-powered audiobook generation. Supports EPUB, PDF, TXT, and MD formats.

title: Neurofind
tagline: AI-assisted diagnosis of mental disorders from 3D brain MRI.
description: Backend, cloud infrastructure and ML models for Neurofind.ai — taking neuroimaging research toward clinical practice. Flask + Celery + Redis API connecting frontend job requests to a containerised AI backend on AWS.

title: Neuroharmony
tagline: First out-of-sample harmonisation tool for neuroimaging.
description: Open-source tool that mitigates scanner bias in MRI-derived features so models trained on one site generalise to another. Recognised with a £109,000 MRC research grant.

title: Monzo Overdraft GBM
tagline: 20–100% Gini gain on a £259M lending portfolio.
description: GBM-based overdraft-application model serving 7M+ Monzo customers, deployed in Docker on GCP. Refactored Monzo’s internal modelling library to standardise monitoring across all lending products, surfacing previously invisible subgroup performance gaps.

title: Floe Oral Care
tagline: From research concept to deployed clinical tool.
description: Founding ML engineer. Designed the clinical trials, shipped logistic-regression and tree-based diagnostic models plus an OpenAI-backed RAG recommendation system. Built the full AWS CDK infrastructure and Django backend.
